cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, is still preaching to Israel about life in the land the LORD is giving them. The first case: someone is found killed, lying in a field, and nobody knows who did it.
The elders and judges come out and measure the distance from the body to the towns around it.

cards.question: Once the elders and judges measure from the body of the man nobody knows who killed, which town's elders take the next step?

answers.text: The largest town in the land
The town where the man lived

cards.text: Those elders take a heifer that's never been yoked or worked. They bring it to a valley with running water, on ground never plowed or sown, and break its neck there by the stream.

cards.question: At the stream where the elders break the heifer's neck over a killing nobody can solve, the priests, the sons of Levi, come forward. Why does Moses say they are there?

answers.text: God chose them to serve and rule on cases
They live in the city nearest the field
They were the ones who found the victim

cards.text: Then all the elders of the nearest town wash their hands by the stream over the heifer.

cards.question: As they wash their hands over the heifer by the stream, the elders of the nearest city declare that they saw who killed the man.

cards.text: They declare that their hands didn't shed this blood and their eyes didn't see it. And they go on, "Accept this atonement, O LORD, for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them."

cards.question: After the elders of the nearest city say, "Accept this atonement, O LORD…" Moses says the bloodshed will be atoned for.
With the heifer, the washing and the declaration over a killing nobody can solve, Israel purges the ___ of shedding innocent blood from among them.
Moses says that when Israel follows these steps for a killing nobody can solve, they have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

cards.text: Next, Moses covers captives taken in war. If a man sees a beautiful woman among the captives and wants her as his wife, he brings her into his house.
She shaves her head, trims her nails and puts aside the clothing of her captivity. After she mourns her father and mother for a full month, she becomes his wife.

cards.question: If a man marries a woman captured in war and then isn't pleased with her, Moses says he's allowed to sell her for money.
A man who married a captive woman and isn't pleased with her must let her go wherever she wishes and never treat her as a slave. What reason does Moses give?

answers.text: She came from a royal family
Her people might come for her

cards.text: Then Moses turns to inheritance. If a man has two wives, one loved and one unloved, both may give him sons, and the firstborn may be the unloved wife's son.

cards.question: If a man's firstborn son comes from his unloved wife, Moses says that son keeps the firstborn's place over the loved wife's son.

cards.text: Which wife he loves more doesn't change which son came first. Friend, I've got favorite batches, but the FIRST batch out of my oven is still the first batch. That's just math.

cards.question: What must the father give the firstborn son of his unloved wife?

answers.text: A double portion of all he has
The family house and all its land
Half of all his flocks and herds

cards.question: Why does Moses say the right of the firstborn belongs to the unloved wife's son?

answers.text: He's the first son born of his father's strength
His mother asked the elders to give it to him
He has always been the strongest of the sons

cards.text: Now a heavy one. If a son is stubborn and rebellious and won't listen to his father and mother even when they discipline him, they take hold of him and bring him to the elders at the gate of his hometown.

cards.question: At the city gate, the parents of a stubborn son tell the elders he won't obey them. What else do they say about him?

answers.text: He is a glutton and a drunkard
He has stolen from his neighbors
He has lied to the whole city

cards.text: Moses says all the men of his city will then stone him to death.

cards.question: After the stubborn and rebellious son is put to death, Moses says, so you must purge the ___ from among you.
Moses says the rebellious son's case is kept quiet so the rest of Israel never hears about it.

cards.text: Then the last case. If a man commits a sin worthy of death, is executed, and his body is hung on a tree, Moses gives a rule about the body.

cards.question: If an executed man's body is hung on a tree, what does Moses say Israel must do with it?

answers.text: Leave it up for three days
Keep it up until the elders say

cards.question: The executed man's body can't stay on the tree overnight, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God's ___.

cards.text: Moses adds that they must not defile the land the LORD their God is giving them as an inheritance. Later, Paul, an apostle of Jesus, points back to this line and writes that Christ became a curse for us (Galatians 3:13).
That's where we'll pause, friend. Moses has plenty more to say.
